decisions.reason: As an adjacent dumper variant that reuses core engineering, sales and service capabilities, it is inexpensive to keep on the market and there is still no clear negative signal that would justify abandoning it.

This mine rescue vehicle remains the weakest and most uncertain option because it serves a narrow, more distant niche, but in a long-cycle underground market the firm would likely keep the option open one more year rather than exit immediately.
A telescopic loader line with several models reflects broader commitment and capability reuse, so the option value of staying in the segment still clearly exceeds the cost of continuation.
The material-lift line is close to the core offer and the reported large order is strong early evidence of demand, making withdrawal within a year unlikely.
Although it is farther from the established range, the mining loader's strong operating evidence after only a few months materially reduces uncertainty and supports keeping the product on the market.
